Callout.Name: Public Intoxication
Callout.Message: Person asleep in a doorway, very drunk.
Callout.Advisory: Male, no injuries seen, businesses complaining.

Lines.Approach: He is asleep in the doorway and he smells like a brewery. Do not let him sleep it off in this weather.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
